name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge for hamstrings and glutes with strong posterior chain loading.
setup: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs, feet hip width.
execution: Hinge at hips pushing them back, lower dumbbells along legs, drive hips forward.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on drive

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg RDL
description: Unilateral hip hinge building hamstring strength and balance.
setup: Stand on one leg, dumbbell in opposite hand, free arm out for balance.
execution: Hinge forward driving free leg back, lower dumbbell toward floor, drive hips forward.
breathing: Inhale on hinge, exhale on stand

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
description: Hip-hinge emphasizing spinal erectors and hamstrings.
setup: Stand with feet hip width, hold dumbbell at chest.
execution: Hinge at hips, lower torso until parallel, drive hips forward to stand.
breathing: Inhale on lower, exhale on drive
progression: Heavier weight or pause at bottom

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
description: Floor-based hip extension isolating the glutes with load.
setup: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat, dumbbell on hip crease.
execution: Drive hips up squeezing glutes, pause at top, lower with control.
breathing: Exhale on drive, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
description: Bench-supported hip thrust for maximum glute activation.
setup: Upper back on bench, feet flat, dumbbell on hip crease.
execution: Drive hips up to full extension, squeeze glutes 2 seconds, lower.
breathing: Exhale on drive, inhale on lower
